TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ID,ADB,ADB_UPD_DT,[ALIAS],BRANCH_CD,CIF,CORP_ID,CURRENCY_CD,DEL,EXTERNAL_REMARKS,HOST_NAME,ACCOUNT_STATUS,INTERNAL_REMARKS,IS_OWN,NAME,NO,OUT_DT,PREV_STATUS,REF_NO,SS_DT,STATUS,TYPE_CD,UPDATED_BY,UPDATED_DT,VCN,VERSION,LAST6_NO))
	 AS HASHROW,
	ID
	,VERSION,DEL
FROM (	SELECT
[ID]
,[ACCOUNT_STATUS]
,convert(numeric(15,2),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ADB],' ',''),''),0)) as ADB
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[ADB_UPD_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as ADB_UPD_DT
,[ALIAS]
,[BRANCH_CD]
,[CIF]
,[CORP_ID]
,[CURRENCY_CD]
,[DEL]
,[EXTERNAL_REMARKS]
,[HOST_NAME]
,[INTERNAL_REMARKS]
,[IS_OWN]
,[NAME]
,[NO]
,[LAST6_NO]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[OUT_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as OUT_DT
,convert(numeric(15,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PREV_STATUS],' ',''),''),0)) AS PREV_STATUS
,[REF_NO]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[SS_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as SS_DT
,[STATUS]
,[TYPE_CD]
,[UPDATED_BY]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[UPDATED_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as UPDATED_DT
,[VCN]
,convert(numeric(15,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VERSION],' ',''),''),0)) as VERSION



,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]

,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]

,[FILE_NAME]

,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [d360].[STG_BOB_TBLACCOUNT]
   WHERE H = 'D'
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ID,ADB,ADB_UPD_DT,[ALIAS],BRANCH_CD,CIF,CORP_ID,CURRENCY_CD,DEL,EXTERNAL_REMARKS,HOST_NAME,ACCOUNT_STATUS,INTERNAL_REMARKS,IS_OWN,NAME,NO,OUT_DT,PREV_STATUS,REF_NO,SS_DT,STATUS,TYPE_CD,UPDATED_BY,UPDATED_DT,VCN,VERSION,LAST6_NO))
	 AS HASHROW,
	ID
	,VERSION,DEL
FROM	BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ID,VERSION,DEL,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ID,TGT.ID) AS ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.VERSION,TGT.VERSION) AS VERSION
	,ISNULL(SRC.DEL,TGT.DEL) AS DEL

	,CASE WHEN SRC.ID IS NULL AND SRC.VERSION IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ID IS NULL AND SRC.VERSION IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.DEL = '1' THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.ID IS NULL AND TGT.VERSION IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHERE SRC.HASHROW != TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ID = TGT.ID
AND SRC.VERSION = TGT.VERSION

	
WHERE	(
TGT.ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.VERSION IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
